name: ai-gateway.decide-batch
purpose: Answer typed decision questions about up to 32 states with a decision model, keeping each item's answers, probabilities, method, provider, locality and usage.

states.description: 1 to 32 nonempty texts; at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes each and 131072 total.

questions.description: 1 to 4 questions with distinct ids of at most 64 bytes: {id, type: choice|score|noul, instructions?, options?: {label: description} or [labels] (2-12, labels at most 32 bytes; object keys may be reordered by JSON transports, so pass [labels] when order matters), levels?: [2-10 level descriptions, level 0 first], true?, false?}.

role.description: decide.fast (default; local Laya first) or decide.accurate (local Winnow first).

assumptions: AI Gateway serves decide.fast and decide.accurate through its governed decide-batch binding.
Hosted decision candidates without provisioned credentials are skipped by the gateway, not failed.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every execution path.
One batch RPC at most; the candidate walk and answer validation remain bounded by AI Gateway.
Only answers inside each question's declared closed set count toward answered or by_choice.
Every requested index is retained when a positional result is missing or invalid.
Input texts are not copied into the result envelope.

signals.results: Ordered item evidence: answers by question id (value, confidence, probabilities listed in the option or level order of inputs.questions), method, provider, model, locality and latency, or an indexed error.
signals.by_choice: Counts of answered choice labels per question id.
signals.methods: Answered items per method (DECISION_MODEL or LLM_ENUM).
signals.answered: Number of items whose every answer is inside its declared set.
signals.usage: Owner-supplied batch usage; null when unavailable or invalid.
signals.candidates: The first item's candidate walk: provider/resource-role to skip or failure reason, showing which hosted candidates lack credentials.

outputs.evidence: Batch binding, role and item count; provider, method and measured usage live in item evidence.
